title: Modulatory effects of extract of Heinsia crinita against fructose/streptozotocin-induced oxidative stress in diabetic rat models.
authors: Iwara, Iwara A; Mboso, Eve O; Ibor, Oju R; Elot, Kelvin; Igajah, Collin; Bassey, Andem A; Eteng, Ofem E; Mgbeje, Bob I A; Igile, Godwin O; Eteng, Mbeh U; Arukwe, Augustine
one_liner_zh: 该文研究植物提取物对糖尿病大鼠氧化应激的调节作用，仅含少量分子对接分析TF-DNA结合域，主体为动物实验与基因表达检测，非TF-DNA互作核心研究。
abstract: Oxidative stress plays a crucial role in the development of type 2 diabetes and the associated microvascular and cardiovascular complications. In the study, we have investigated the effects of Heinsia crinita (H. crinita) extracts on lipid peroxidation and oxidative stress responses using diabetic rats. Type 2 diabetes was induced with 10 % fructose/40 mg/kg body weight streptozotocin (STZ). H. crinita extract was administered at 200 and 400 mg/kg body weight twice daily for 21 days, in addition to metformin (MET: 500 mg/kg body weight) control. Molecular docking analysis was performed to determine the binding affinity of H. crinita extracts to the DNA binding domains of peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor (Ppar) and retinoid x receptor (Rxr) protein crystal structures, showing different binding affinities for putative active compounds from the plant. Fasting blood glucose (FBG), body and organ weight changes were determined showing that H. crinita extract induced an anti-hyperglycemic effect in the treated animals, with changes (either decrease or increase) in liver and kidney weights. A decrease in mRNA expression of peroxisome proliferator-activated receptors (ppar), sterol regulatory element-binding protein 1 (srebp-1c), liver x-receptor (lxr), retinoid x receptors (rxr), cytochrome p45041 (cyp4a1) and acyl-CoA oxidase (acox1) in diabetic animals were observed, compared to the control. A dose-specific decrease or increase in antioxidant enzymes (superoxide dismutase: SOD, catalase: CAT, reduced glutathione: GSH, glutathione peroxidase: GPx) transcripts and activity levels were also observed. We also observed exposure-specific decrease or increase of malondialdehyde (MDA) levels. Our data suggested that H. crinita extract possesses protective effects against diabetes-induced oxidative stress. These effects might be attributed to their binding and activation of nuclear receptors, indicating their cellular mode of action that is comparable to MET.
abstract_zh: 氧化应激在2型糖尿病及其相关微血管和心血管并发症的发展中起着关键作用。在本研究中，我们使用糖尿病大鼠探讨了Heinsia crinita（H. crinita）提取物对脂质过氧化和氧化应激反应的影响。通过10%果糖/40 mg/kg体重链脲佐菌素（STZ）诱导2型糖尿病。H. crinita提取物以200和400 mg/kg体重的剂量每日两次给药，持续21天，同时设置二甲双胍（MET：500 mg/kg体重）作为对照。进行了分子对接分析，以确定H. crinita提取物与过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体（Ppar）和维甲酸X受体（Rxr）蛋白晶体结构DNA结合域的结合亲和力，结果显示植物中推定活性化合物具有不同的结合亲和力。测定了空腹血糖（FBG）、体重和器官重量变化，表明H. crinita提取物在处理动物中诱导了抗高血糖效应，并伴有肝脏和肾脏重量的变化（减少或增加）。与对照组相比，糖尿病动物中过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体（ppar）、固醇调节元件结合蛋白1（srebp-1c）、肝X受体（lxr）、维甲酸X受体（rxr）、细胞色素p45041（cyp4a1）和酰基辅酶A氧化酶（acox1）的mRNA表达降低。还观察到抗氧化酶（超氧化物歧化酶：SOD，过氧化氢酶：CAT，还原型谷胱甘肽：GSH，谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶：GPx）转录本和活性水平的剂量特异性降低或增加。我们还观察到丙二醛（MDA）水平的暴露特异性降低或增加。我们的数据表明，H. crinita提取物对糖尿病诱导的氧化应激具有保护作用。这些效应可能归因于它们与核受体的结合和激活，表明其细胞作用模式与MET相当。
